15.name: Baked Crust
15.why: The crust a loaf wears when the peel draws it from the oven, the colour the bread picks for itself.

15.name: Hearth Tile
15.why: A tile the fire has warmed, giving its glow back long after the flame has gone.

15.name: Qvevri Jar
15.why: The potter's qvevri, fired clay that a Georgian cellar keeps its wine in.

16.name: Oak Bark
16.why: Weathered oak bark, the rough skin of wood that has been working for years.

16.name: Garden Soil
16.why: The dark soil a spade turns over, rich with the work of the season before.

16.name: Carved Balcony
16.why: A Tbilisi balcony carved by hand and darkened by decades of weather.
